confidentUnsupported.evidence: Stopping a cycle mid-way by pulling the plug shouldn't cause this fault; modern machines reset safely when power is lost.

blockingLoop.evidence: Please go ahead and check that pump filter now—was it clogged with fluff/debris, or was it already clear?

rationale: The assistant correctly flagged the thermal cut-out and airflow as likely causes and gave no unsafe instructions. It dismissed the interrupted-cycle clue, which was in fact the key fact, and with confidence. It then repeated the same filter request over several turns, never moved to the top-panel heater inspection the customer offered, and never suggested an engineer or someone with a meter to test. The customer also never received an explanation of the one-shot cut-out. The 'pump filter' is not the dryer lint or condenser path, so the checks were partly misdirected.
